protocol: 36-year-old Marine Corps test pilot. Two reported losses of cabin pressure during the second flight that day. The earlier flight was in a different aircraft and maintained cabin pressure.
outcome_window: In-flight disorientation and recurrent postflight neurological deficits. Observed in hospital and discharged after a normal exam.
locator: Case Report and Table II pp. 741–742; Discussion pp. 742–744
note: The original diagnosis remains uncertain and the report favors AGE over DCS or both mechanisms. Possible overlap with Kutz Case 3.
